newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Merger talk ups interest in Clinic, Netcare.
newsitem.headline: Merger talk ups interest in Clinic, Netcare.

text.p: Merger rumours circulating about South African healthcare firms Clinic Holdings Ltd and Network Healthcare Holdings Ltd pushed up interest in both stocks on Monday, dealers said.
Clinic added 10 cents to 580 cents in volumes of 916,300 shares worth 5.3 million rand, while Netcare also put on 10 cents to 226 cents in trade of 1.4 million shares worth 3.1 million rand.
"It is just merger rumours in the market that those two firms will get together," one dealer said.
Netcare and Clinic spokesmen contacted by Reuters declined to comment on the rumours.
However, both firms are trading under cautionary statements issued earlier this year.
Clinic said on June 5 that its controlling shareholders were still in talks which could have an impact on its share price and urged shareholders to exercise caution in their dealings.
In February Netcare also warned its shareholders that it was in talks that could have an impact upon its share price.

Netcare only listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange last December and in May posted a maiden set of results that came in ahead of forecasts. It posted earnings per share of 3.8 cents and a dividend of one cent.
